notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ» names only the pronoun for the one asked: the Imam is taken from prev1, which writes «أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» as its last name (owner ruling, inherited opener).
«وَ سَأَلَهُ» names only the pronoun for the one asked: the Imam is taken from prev1, which writes «أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» as its last name (owner ruling, inherited opener).

«وَ سَأَلَهُ لَيْثٌ اَلْمُرَادِيُّ» : the asker is written; «سأله» points at the Imam of prev1 (3013: «رَوَى جَمِيلٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»), the last name of its chain: inherited, last link after the asker
the saying is the Imam's answer to the asker, so the inherited Imam is the last link
